question: For 15 innings, a cricketer has an average of 94 runs. In the 16th inning, he scores 111 runs. His average score increased by _____. (Round off the answer to the nearest whole number.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Deviation of the 16th inning score from the old average = 111 − 94 = 17 runs.

This extra 17 runs will be equally distributed among all the 16 innings to find the net increase.

Increase in average = 17 ÷ 16 = 1.0625 runs.

Rounded off to the nearest whole number, the increase is 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 run.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs for 15 innings = 94

Score in the 16th inning = 111

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of observations ÷ Total number of observations

 
 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
 15 Innings (Avg = 94)
 
 
• 
 Extra = +17
 16th Inning
 (Base = 94)
 

 Distribute +17 to all 16 innings
 Net Increase = 17 ÷ 16 ≈ 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total runs scored in 15 innings = 15 × 94 = 1410

⇒ Total runs scored in 16 innings = 1410 + 111 = 1521

⇒ New average after 16 innings = 1521 ÷ 16

⇒ New average = 95.0625

⇒ Increase in average score = 95.0625 − 94 = 1.0625

⇒ Rounding off to the nearest whole number, the increase is 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 run.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inclusion Method (Net Deviation)

When a new value is added, the change in average is equal to the difference between the new value and the old average, divided by the new total number of observations: Change = (New Value − Old Average) ÷ New Count.

Combined Average

To combine two groups with averages A₁ and A₂ and sizes N₁ and N₂, the combined average is calculated as: (N₁A₁ + N₂A₂) ÷ (N₁ + N₂).

Exclusion Method

When a value is removed, the change in average depends on whether the removed value was higher or lower than the average. If the removed value is higher than the group average, the new average decreases.
